title: Record Findings as You Find Them
tagline: Partial progress survives a truncation. An array at the end of the context does not.

story.problem: A research specialist returned every vendor that it found in one closing JSON blob. That design made each finding depend on the last token. A truncated reply, a transient provider error, or a cancelled turn lost the whole category. The loss was silent, because an empty result from a specialist looks the same as a market with no vendors.
story.solution: The record_vendor tool writes each vendor to the KV research store at the moment of verification, and the tool accepts exactly one finding. The planner reads the findings back with get_research, which joins the findings to the live trace. Thus a truncated specialist, a stalled specialist, an all-refused specialist, and a genuinely empty category each produce a different instruction. We deleted the subagent's outputSchema. A structured return on a long-running child session changes a format miss into OUTPUT_SCHEMA_NOT_FULFILLED and stops the session. The schema also guarantees nothing that the durable store does not already hold.
story.outcome: Partial progress now survives an interruption. A count of zero recorded vendors became a detectable failure, and the planner re-runs only the truncated specialist. The schema deletion alone scored 33/37 on npm run eval:scout. The run that measured 3-4 vendors per specialist with zero truncations scored 52/53, and that run also carried a later guardrail fix. The cheaper model that carried the schema failed 10 of 10 child sessions and recorded no vendor.

prerequisites: An Upstash Redis REST endpoint (UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL + UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN, or the KV_REST_API_* pair injected by the Vercel integration)
A Nebius Token Factory API key (NEBIUS_API_KEY) and a Tavily key (TAVILY_API_KEY)
A declared subagent whose tool surface you control — see recipe 02
A brief in evals/data/briefs.json to drive an end-to-end run

quickstart.clone: git clone https://github.com/jaredwerba/vendor-scout.git && cd vendor-scout && npm install
quickstart.configure: Create .env.local with NEBIUS_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY and the Upstash REST pair (UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN). Without the store, record_vendor returns not_configured and the run degrades to closing reports.

endpoints.description: One agent tree — the planner, every specialist, their recorded event logs, and the live per-category count of vendors written to the research store.
